summary: Dispatched to implement Phases 7 (do first) and 6, both REOPENED by a prior exclusion audit (commit b616dfd1). Phase 6 (Sorry visibility) is now genuinely COMPLETED: re-verified the live 18-site warn.sorry count (all declaration-scoped, 0 file-scoped) matches the reopen's per-file breakdown exactly (SuccRelation.lean 7, UntilSinceCoherence.lean 2, BXCanonical/Frame.lean 1, TemporalConservativity.lean 1, BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleToCountermodel.lean 7 -- note: NOT Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/ChronicleToCountermodel.lean, a same-named sibling file with zero warn.sorry sites). Read all 18 sites individually; every one already documents a technical-blocker reason at the site (external 'WeakCanonical discrete-completeness port' dependency) -- no new comments needed, no task-number citations found. Measured, via a scratch/uncommitted/fully-reverted experiment (all 18 set_option lines temporarily no-op'd across all 5 files, one lake build --wfail --iofail run, then every file restored from backup and re-diffed to confirm zero net change before any commit), the actual warning count if all 18 suppressions were removed: 21 additional warnings, not 18 (2 of ChronicleToCountermodel.lean's 7 declarations are structures with multiple independently-warning sorry'd fields) -- corrects the plan's prior '23-sorry census' figure to 26 (5 existing + 21). Recorded the asymmetry disposition: suppression retained and justified (Propositional/Modal's 5 unsuppressed sorries have no analogous external-port dependency; removing the suppression today would revert the CI-gate-restoration headline result from 5 to 26 warnings), with an explicit trigger to revisit once the WeakCanonical port lands upstream. Phase 7 (Script and documentation defects) is only PARTIAL -- 0 of its 2 reopened items landed, both excluded by finding after genuine investigation (not skipped): (1) NOTATION.md's 'Logic notation scoping' section was drafted, then found to be blocked by this dispatch's own hard constraint -- `git cat-file -e upstream/main:NOTATION.md` exits 0, meaning the file is byte-identical to upstream/main and therefore out of scope under the upstream-exposure carve-out (same carve-out Phase 5 already applies to 12 shared .lean files). The draft was reverted before commit (`git checkout -- NOTATION.md`); zero net change landed. (2) The '5 stale NOTE: block deletions' were located and read in full; they are NOT stale -- each is a live, currently-accurate explanation of why that specific Bimodal/Temporal file needs @-positional application instead of a named (S := ...) argument, because the S/Since notation collision the reopen itself wants documented in NOTATION.md still exists (the S->Sys rename that would obviate these comments remains deferred, unchanged from the prior close). Deleting them would have removed load-bearing documentation for no compensating benefit, so they were deliberately left in place rather than deleted as literally instructed. Both findings and their full reasoning are recorded in the plan's Phase 7 section and the Definition of Done. Neither Phase 3 nor Phase 5 (both also currently open/PARTIAL from prior cycles) was touched by this dispatch -- out of scope per the delegation instructions.

Did not touch Phase 3 or Phase 5 -- both explicitly out of scope for this dispatch per the delegation instructions.
